what: Independent CURATION_SPEC 11.4 release sample of the nissan candidate (groups/_report/nissan.candidate.json, raw oem-raw@57e8b5b9). Verifier did not write the rules and did not read the builder's verdicts before writing these.

draw.method: Verifier's own draw (not audit11_4/sample.py): 30 groups, per-category quota (>=1 each, rest by largest remainder), round-robin over strata X cross-make / G cross-generation / S single-year windows / O other inside each category; 30 pairs from the other groups, one per group, seeker and donor of different feed models, random years. No cross-make groups exist in the candidate, so X is empty.

evidence_sources: Raw records read from git (oem-raw@57e8b5b9 raw/www.nissanpartsdeal.com.* and raw/www.infinitipartsdeal.com.*; Lnnn = line in <site>.lists.jsonl, product Lnnn = line in <site>.jsonl). Lot mix from main@a85c654 inventory_live.json (sha256 1a9cfa73...) and vin_decodes.json.gz (1357625b...). Two web searches, search-result text only ('82730-9FJ0A window motor Titan crew cab'; 'Nissan Titan King Cab rear access door window fixed'): the first summary names 'Crew Cab' for 82730-9FJ0A, the second settles nothing; no page fetched, no catalog or competitor site opened.

rubric.RIGHT: Every named vehicle-year lists the number (own list page, or the product record's own seed page / fitment row when the vehicle-year has no list page for the category), and each remaining restriction is a trim/package option (covered by the option/configurations note), a production window overlapping the model year by >=5 months (hub rule (a), curate._production_excludes), or a cab code the note names correctly.
rubric.WRONG: A named vehicle-year where, by the evidence, no US car can carry the number (body, engine, drive, cab, market, years, window, side); or a vehicle-year built in two or more bodies or drive types where the rows limit the number to one and the group has no body/drive gate or note (CLAUDE.md rule 3: body gate, drive gate).
rubric.RISK: Every named vehicle-year lists the number, but part of a vehicle-year cannot carry it for a reason the note does not name and that is not an equipment option: a second engine or transmission under the same model name, or a cab split the catalog rows do not mark. Under the brief's literal wording ('any car the group would show as a donor cannot carry that part number') these are WRONG; the spec treats ENGINE/TRANS clauses as a 'maybe' cover, which is what Likely means. Counted separately so the hub can apply either reading.

census.what: Verifier census over all 343 shippable candidate groups for the two WRONG classes found in the sample (own reader, scratch script census_drive_body.py; vehicle-years with no own list page are not judged, so this is a lower bound).
census.rule: DRIVE: every Fitting Vehicle Options configuration of the number on a named vehicle-year own page names one drive (4WD/AWD/4X4, or 2WD/4X2) while the same page lists another number of the same part name for the other drive. BODY: every configuration names a sedan code (4S/2S/S/SED/SEDAN) and no coupe code on a coupe-only feed model (200SX).
